Re-created 2026-11-15 from forgotten rules-greg-questly-engram-marker-2026-11-06 rev 2, minus third-party details.
GREG, 2026-11-06 about 13:10Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #377, message 2fddd004), verbatim: „Wole trwałe czyli B”. He was answering a concrete proposal: a separate commit of ONLY `.engram-project` (content: the Questly project id) in the Questly repo, and a push of Questly main that also includes the already-local commit a771b9e5.
Asistant's conditions: keep every other staged and unstaged change; no force or rebase; then bring the commit to DL560 by a supported route; don't use .git/info/exclude.
OUTCOME (13:25Z, Questly::Codex2 session-6702 report):
- Marker commit f50714e9 ("chore: declare Questly Engram project", only .engram-project).
- Remote main had moved to 45c55a5 (an unrelated upstream change). The direct push was stopped. Greg then explicitly approved a merge and push: „Tak” via Asistant #9 to that session (message 930be19b), with Fable2 #16 specifying an isolated worktree.
- Merge c2f803b5 (parents f50714e and 45c55a5) was made in a detached temporary worktree and pushed plainly: 45c55a5..c2f803b. Relative to the old remote, the outgoing content is only .engram-project and termal-tests.toml.
- Greg's local main stays at f50714e, now behind origin by the merge. His local uncommitted work is unchanged.
- DL560 clone fast-forwarded to c2f803b.
DL560 Questly store created: /home/greg/.engram, `engram init --project-file …/questly/.engram-project`, policy 9a941271…. The TermAl project is connected (EO on); verify ready:true; readiness ready:true. Flutter 3.47.9 at /home/greg/flutter (not on PATH). The Engram runner on DL560 stays unconnected.
